		SELECT r.session_id, r.seq, r.entry_id, CASE WHEN r.parent_type = 'text' THEN r.parent_id END,
			CASE WHEN instr(r.entry_json, '"worktree_snapshot"') > 0 AND json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.type') = 'worktree_snapshot' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.root') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId') = 'text' THEN r.seq WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snapshot_session_links AS p WHERE p.session_id = r.session_id AND p.entry_id = r.parent_id AND r.parent_type = 'text') THEN (SELECT p.anchor_seq FROM snapshot_session_links AS p WHERE p.session_id = r.session_id AND p.entry_id = r.parent_id AND r.parent_type = 'text' ORDER BY p.seq LIMIT 1) ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN up.anchor_seq IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(
		(SELECT up.anchor_seq - cs.from_seq + cs.base_seq + 1 FROM session_fork_segments AS cs WHERE cs.session_id = r.session_id AND cs.source_id = up.session_id AND up.anchor_seq BETWEEN cs.from_seq AND cs.to_seq),
		(SELECT up.anchor_seq - ss.base_seq - 1 + ss.from_seq - cs.from_seq + cs.base_seq + 1 FROM session_fork_segments AS ss JOIN session_fork_segments AS cs ON cs.session_id = r.session_id AND cs.source_id = ss.source_id AND up.anchor_seq - ss.base_seq - 1 + ss.from_seq BETWEEN cs.from_seq AND cs.to_seq WHERE ss.session_id = up.session_id AND up.anchor_seq BETWEEN ss.base_seq + 1 AND ss.base_seq + ss.to_seq - ss.from_seq + 1),
		(SELECT own.seq FROM snapshot_session_links AS own WHERE own.session_id = r.session_id AND own.entry_id = COALESCE((SELECT a.entry_id FROM snapshot_session_links AS a WHERE a.session_id = up.session_id AND a.seq = up.anchor_seq), (SELECT a.entry_id FROM session_fork_segments AS ss JOIN snapshot_session_links AS a ON a.session_id = ss.source_id AND a.seq = up.anchor_seq - ss.base_seq - 1 + ss.from_seq WHERE ss.session_id = up.session_id AND up.anchor_seq BETWEEN ss.base_seq + 1 AND ss.base_seq + ss.to_seq - ss.from_seq + 1)) ORDER BY own.seq LIMIT 1),
		(SELECT x.seq - cs.from_seq + cs.base_seq + 1 FROM session_fork_segments AS cs JOIN snapshot_session_links AS x ON x.session_id = cs.source_id AND x.entry_id = COALESCE((SELECT a.entry_id FROM snapshot_session_links AS a WHERE a.session_id = up.session_id AND a.seq = up.anchor_seq), (SELECT a.entry_id FROM session_fork_segments AS ss JOIN snapshot_session_links AS a ON a.session_id = ss.source_id AND a.seq = up.anchor_seq - ss.base_seq - 1 + ss.from_seq WHERE ss.session_id = up.session_id AND up.anchor_seq BETWEEN ss.base_seq + 1 AND ss.base_seq + ss.to_seq - ss.from_seq + 1)) AND x.seq BETWEEN cs.from_seq AND cs.to_seq WHERE cs.session_id = r.session_id ORDER BY cs.base_seq, x.seq LIMIT 1)
